# CompanyEnrich

CompanyEnrich provides instant company data enrichment, search, and similar company discovery through API endpoints.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/companyenrich/.

## Actions

- **Enrich company by domain** (read-only): Enriches a company using its domain name as lookup parameter.
- **Enrich company by properties** (read-only): Enriches a company using its properties.
- **Lookup Person by Email** (read-only): Look up a person by email address.
- **Search companies by criteria**: Searches companies based on given criteria.
- **Search People**: Searches people based on given criteria using page-based pagination.
- **Autocomplete Companies** (read-only): Returns a list of companies matching the given partial domain name.
- **Autocomplete Keywords** (read-only): Lookup keywords for use in company search filters.
- **Autocomplete Positions** (read-only): Lookup positions/job titles for use in people search filters.
- **Autocomplete Technologies** (read-only): Lookup technologies for use in company search filters.
- **Batch Enrich Companies**: Enriches a list of companies using their domain names.
- **Count companies matching search criteria**: Returns the total count of companies matching the given search criteria without retrieving the actual results.
- **Count Similar Companies**: Count the total number of similar companies matching the given search criteria without retrieving the actual results.
- **Create people search export job**: Creates an asynchronous search export job for up to 50,000 people.
- **Create search export job**: Creates an asynchronous search export job for company data.
- **Find Similar Companies**: Find similar companies to the given company by domain.
- **Get Bulk Enrichment Job Status** (read-only): Returns the current status of a bulk enrichment job.
- **Get Company Workforce** (read-only): Returns workforce insights for a single company.
- **Get Country by Code** (read-only): Search for a country by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Returns information about the authenticated user, including their API key, credit balance, and account capabilities.
- **Get Job Details** (read-only): Returns details for a specific job by ID.
- **Get People Search Export Job Status**: Returns the current status of a person search export job.
- **Get Regions** (read-only): Get all available regions.
- **Get search export job status** (read-only): Returns the current status of a search export job.
- **List all jobs** (read-only): Returns a paginated list of all jobs (bulk enrichment, etc.) for the authenticated user.
- **List bulk enrichment jobs** (read-only): Returns a paginated list of all bulk enrichment jobs for the authenticated user.
- **List Industries** (read-only): Obtain a list of all company industries.
- **List Person Search Export Jobs** (read-only): Returns a paginated list of all person search export jobs for the authenticated user.
- **List search export jobs** (read-only): Returns a paginated list of all search export jobs for the authenticated user.
- **Search cities by name or country** (read-only): Search for cities by name or country codes.
- **Search Countries** (read-only): Search countries by name.
- **Search people with cursor pagination**: Searches people based on given criteria using cursor-based pagination.
- **Search States** (read-only): Search states by name or country codes.
